'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Shannon LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Shannon]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
